title: Full-stack streaming and user workflows
subtitle: Carry backend truth into browser state, confirmation, and feedback.
goal: Show users what has actually happened
intro: The interface should explain progress and recovery without mistaking partial text for a completed action.
terms: The persisted outcome the application trusts
flow: Persisted result or clear incomplete state
case: A user sees a draft response while an external operation is still pending.
The UI distinguishes reading progress from committed effects.
A cheerful done message can appear before persistence.
